M2TMNXSLV.missing_handling: netCDF fill converted to NaN at assembly
notes: Temperature differences (slopes) are identical in K and C.

GLDAS_NOAH025_M.missing_handling: land-only model output; source fill -9999 -> NaN
notes: Not a percentage and not relative humidity.
Cells that are missing are missing for all 288 months (no on/off behaviour); see coverage_report.json.

evidence.decision: Do not exclude cells on the quality index. Observed values in all three windows are far below a 0-100 style threshold (medians 5-7), so a fixed cut such as 50 or 80 would remove 100% of the data.

GPM_3IMERGM.recommended_use: Report the quality index and randomError next to every precipitation number; use them for weighting or caveats, not silent exclusion.
GPM_3IMERGM.unit_conversion: mm/month = value(mm/hr) x hours_in_month; state the conversion in the evidence card.

MOD13C2.default_mask: MODLAND QA bits 0-1 accepted, bits 2-3 masked; pixel_reliability 0-1 accepted, 2-4 flagged not excluded by the data layer
MOD13C2.strict_mask: MODLAND QA bits == 0 only; pixel_reliability == 0 only
notes: Bits 2-3 (pixel not produced) already appear as NaN in the cube; they are not zeros.
NDVI is not a temperature or a precipitation proxy; do not reuse temperature colour scales.
Spatial comparison across windows must state that the windows have different vegetation regimes.

display_rules.insufficient_data_threshold: if a window/month has < 30% valid cells, show insufficient-data instead of a slope
